reviews.review: Can't believe I'm giving a positive review for this game, but they really turned it around. The updates over the whole year changed the game for the better and now you can actually have fun playing it. Shame it was such a disappointment when it released. Now it is worth playing.

B4B is definetly an intense zombie slasher game where you can experience lots infected, interesting special infected and smooth gunplay. It's by far no successor of L4D2, i mean this is alright as it isn't L4D3. It's an own game with it's own style, but surely influenced by L4D2 and World War Z. Keep in mind that this review is only about the Solo Campaign. Thankfully it has been added and the bots aren't that uselesss.
Let's have a look at the pros and cons of this game.

Cons:
- You can't pause the singleplayer
- No toggable flashlight (either automatically in dark areas or you have the flashlight "card")
- No community workshop, instead there are several DLC's.
- If you die during the campaign and have no "continues" left you need to restart a couple of level. This is just frustrating and time consuming.
- During the level your max life decreases (Trauma damage), then you need to refresh your life at an random health station. This is also unnecessary complicated and time consuming.
- The gore effects aren't that detailed

Pros:
- The gunplay is very smooth and satisfying
- Very interesting special infected. I hate some of them so much (Ogre or Hag) but they belong to this game as they are a real challenge and tough to beat.
- The overall Gameplay is smooth and enjoyable.
- This Leveldesign is really awesome as the levels have so much life in it. Some of them are also really scary and in general well structured.
- Zoom in is possible with every gun in the game.
- The different characters enable some custimzation of your playstyle as each of them has it's own strength.

To sum up: I can definetly recommend this game. If it's in Sale below 20 Bucks and you did enjoy L4D2 or World War Z you won't regret this buy. But you need to remember that this isn't L4D3, it's B4B and has it's own strengths and weaknesses. If you have not that much trouble with the Cons I listed you are going to enjoy this game so much.
But after all I will never get over the fact that you can't toggle the Flashlight or pause in Singleplayer, this are so small things, neverthless they have a huge Impact on playing.

Pretty graphics but derivative, and boring gameplay leads to being something only to play if really into formulaic zombie killing and the occasional annoying glitch (get tossed in water, pinned under - cannot swim out, cannot die. Just listen to the ineffectual screams of others.).
GOOD GAME, PPL KINDA SUCK PLAY WITH FRIENDS.
